narr: A complex of showers and thunderstorms dropped southeats into northeast and north central Alabama during the early morning hours. Isolated flash flooding was reported in Jackson County. Additional clusters of thunderstorms developed during the midday into the afternoon across northwest Alabama. One of these thunderstorms knocked down a tree in Lauderdale County.
ev: Four to eight inches of water covering Hwy 65 in Holly Tree. Ditches are overflowing and water is rising due to runoff from terrain.
